Hello! I am LawPilot AI, your expert and ethical Indian legal assistant. Below is the formal legal demand notice drafted for the return of your security deposit.

### | Formal Legal Demand Notice

To,  
[Landlord's Name]  
[Landlord's Address]  

**Date:** [Insert Date]  

**Subject: Legal demand notice for the refund of security deposit amounting to ₹20,000 under the Model Tenancy Act, 2021 and Transfer of Property Act, 1882.**  

Sir/Madam,  

Under instructions from and on behalf of my client, [Your Name], residing at [Your Current Address/Former Rented Premises Address], I do hereby serve upon you this formal demand notice as under:  

1. That my client was a lawful tenant in your residential premises located at [Insert Rented Property Address] from [Insert Start Date] to [Insert End Date] pursuant to a [Written/Oral] tenancy agreement.  
2. That at the time of commencement of the said tenancy, my client paid a security deposit of ₹20,000 (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) to you, which was duly acknowledged.  
3. That my client peacefully vacated and handed over the vacant possession of the said premises to you on [Insert Date of Vacating] in a clean and proper condition, subject only to reasonable wear and tear as per Section 108(m) of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882.  
4. That despite the peaceful surrender of the premises, you have wrongfully withheld the security deposit of ₹20,000 without any lawful justification or valid contractual deductions, which is in direct violation of the principles governing security deposits under Section 13 of the Model Tenancy Act, 2021.  

I, therefore, call upon you through this notice to refund the entire security deposit of ₹20,000 to my client within 15 (fifteen) days from the receipt of this notice, failing which my client shall be constrained to initiate appropriate legal proceedings against you before the competent Rent Authority or Consumer Commission, as well as file a suit under Section 6 of the Specific Relief Act, 1963, for which you shall be solely liable for all costs and consequences arising therefrom.  

Sincerely,  

[Your Name / Your Advocate's Name]  
[Contact Information]
